sources.title: PeopleGroups.org — Kabyle of Algeria (PGID PG011265)
sources.locator: Current profile fast facts and resource sections: Kabyle in Algeria, Kabyle (kab), aggregate Folk Islam label, GSEC 1 / Engaged yet Unreached, JESUS and Magdalena listings, and linked Bible-resource surfaces. Live PEID identity must be re-fetched before publication.

sources.title: Glottolog 5.3 — Kabyle
sources.publisher: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology / Glottolog
sources.locator: Kabyle spoken L1 language entry: glottocode kaby1243, ISO 639-3 kab, country Algeria.

sources.title: Kabyle Literary History and Questions Related to its Periodization: The Case of Poetry
sources.publisher: Cambridge University Press / Review of Middle East Studies
sources.locator: Historical discussion of Kabyle literary and cultural expression, including post-independence language policy and the role of Kabyle-language poetry/song in cultural renewal.

sources.title: Reflections on Race and Ethnicity in North Africa: Towards a Conceptual Critique of the Arab–Berber Divide
sources.publisher: Cambridge University Press / Review of Middle East Studies
sources.locator: Conceptual critique of fixed Arab/Berber categories in North Africa and the role of colonial and nation-state classification; used as a guardrail against essentializing Kabyle identity.

whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Kabyle in Algeria and ties the record to Kabyle (kab). Glottolog independently identifies Kabyle as a language of Algeria, while academic work documents a substantial Kabyle literary tradition and cautions against treating North African Arab/Amazigh categories as simple, fixed binaries.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate Folk Islam label for this people-group-in-country record. It is retained as source context and not generalized into a statement about every Kabyle person's beliefs or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: This candidate explains the current unreached classification only from PeopleGroups.org mission-status evidence. Amazigh identity, language, regional history and religion are not treated as causes of mission status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current source mission status
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports PG011265 below the 2% evangelical threshold with GSEC 1 and no recent church-planting activity, while its SPI presentation is Engaged yet Unreached.

whyUnreached.heading: Reported language resources do not prove universal access
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Kabyle-language films and Bible-resource links; those listings are preserved as provider facts rather than converted into claims about distribution, comprehension or use.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile PG011265 identifies the people-group record as Kabyle in Algeria and lists Kabyle (kab) as its primary language.
claims.interpretationNote: The public profile establishes PGID/name/country/language alignment; the guarded maintainer review must re-fetch the live record and verify PEID before publication.

claims.text: Glottolog identifies Kabyle with glottocode kaby1243 and ISO 639-3 code kab and lists Algeria as its country.

Academic literary history documents Kabyle-language poetry and song as important forms of cultural expression and describes a twentieth-century renewal of written and performed Kabyle cultural production.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a literary-historical observation, not a claim that all Kabyle individuals participate in the same cultural forms.

claims.text: Scholarship on North African identity cautions that Arab/Amazigh categories have been shaped by colonial and state classification as well as local self-identification; this candidate therefore treats the PeopleGroups Kabyle label as a scoped source identity rather than a complete description of every person's identity.
claims.interpretationNote: The synthesis is a guardrail against essentialism and does not replace the provider's source identity with a new taxonomy.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org Kabyle of Algeria profile reports Folk Islam as its aggregate primary-religion label.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for PG011265, not a statement about every Kabyle person's belief or practice.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG011265, while presenting the record as Engaged yet Unreached.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile lists JESUS and Magdalena film entries on the Kabyle (kab) resource surface and links Kabyle Bible-resource providers.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider resource links do not establish distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness.
